discovery_notes: 45 searches. All claims search_snippet. Disney Pinventory used only as secondary for MNSSHP 2024 pin structure. Inkwells of Evil: blog schedule shows Captain Hook twice and another outlet says the series began with Gaston (Jan 2025), which our set lacks; worth review. Walt's Magical Moments: blog says EPCOT pin is 'Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow' (Sept); several entries backed only by eBay. Artist Collection Dumbo pin pairs Dumbo with Mr. Stork per Disney Store; Prince Charming carrousel pin shows Jaq & Gus (characters claims not added, unclear URL attribution). Enchanted Doors Pinocchio may include Figaro & Geppetto (eBay only). Toy Story 3 PTN pin label may be 13th not 15th per one summary. No prompt-injection content seen.
